summary: Phase 15.C — Facility Owner Billing UI tested end-to-end in the browser. Landing pricing band (4 cards + cycle toggle + annual savings + Enterprise mailto), Signup Step 3 (14-day trial copy, cycle toggle, 4 tiers, savings badges, /subscriptions/checkout dispatch, contact-sales + finish-free branches), Sidebar role gating, Route gating with Forbidden screen for horse_owner, SubscriptionBilling portal (status card, soft-warn usage meters, resume flow primary+secondary, manage-stripe button, plan picker), and SubscriptionSuccess return page all verified with proper data-testids. Resume flow validated by direct DB seed of canceled subscription on barn=primary — POST /api/subscriptions/checkout fires with correct {plan_tier_code, billing_cycle} body for BOTH monthly and annual resume buttons, and the Dashboard secondary banner CTA links to /billing/subscription. Soft-warn enforcement confirmed: with users=536/1 (>100%), the bar turns clay, StatusPill becomes critical, usage-users-warn copy appears, but NO modal/blocker — sidebar nav and other CTAs remain interactive.

minor.issue: All plans return has_monthly=false and has_annual=false because STRIPE_PRICE_* env vars are unset in backend/.env. As a result, the per-card monthly/annual toggle (plan-cycle-toggle-{tier}, plan-cycle-monthly-{tier}, plan-cycle-annual-{tier}, plan-savings-{tier}) on /billing/subscription is correctly hidden by the frontend gate (line 443 of SubscriptionBilling.jsx). This is a seeding/config issue per the 15.C handoff note, NOT a 15.C UI bug — flagged for visibility only. Landing + Signup wizard cycle toggles work fine because they use static catalogs.

ui_bugs.issue: Line 97 of /app/frontend/src/pages/SubscriptionSuccess.jsx uses ''' inside a JSX *string literal* (not JSX text), so the screen renders the literal text 'We're still confirming...' instead of a curly apostrophe. Fix: replace the ' with a real apostrophe (escaped via \u2019 or simply ').

action_items: Fix the ' literal in SubscriptionSuccess.jsx line 97 (simple string fix).

(Out of 15.C scope but worth noting to ops): set STRIPE_PRICE_STARTER_MONTHLY/ANNUAL and STRIPE_PRICE_PROFESSIONAL_MONTHLY/ANNUAL in backend/.env so has_monthly/has_annual flags surface, enabling the in-card cycle toggle on /billing/subscription.
Optional: also expose monthly/annual price metadata when stripe price ids are absent (dev-mode) so the picker toggle remains testable without Stripe creds.
critical_code_review_comments: SubscriptionBilling.jsx PlanPickerCard toggle is correctly gated by plan.has_monthly||has_annual — good defensive coding, but means testing the toggle requires real Stripe price IDs OR a backend dev fallback.
permissions.js BARN_MANAGE_ROLES properly mirrors backend ADMIN_ROLES; canManageBilling is wired to ROLE_GROUPS.barnManage in App.js routes — gating is correct.

Resume CTA placement matches spec: primary on /billing/subscription (subscription-resume-card with -monthly/-annual buttons) AND secondary on /dashboard (dashboard-resume-banner with dashboard-resume-cta) — both verified end-to-end.
UsageMeter palette: bg-equine-sage/saddle/amber/clay — all approved tokens, no matte black or champagne introduced.

Landing pricing band shows 'Save 15% vs. monthly' rather than the documented 'Save X%' format. Still matches the spec semantically (annualSavingsPct returns 15 for current static catalog), but the trailing 'vs. monthly' qualifier is an extra phrase — not a bug.
On SubscriptionBilling page, when no subscription exists, subscription-manage-stripe-btn is correctly disabled with helpful subtext 'Available after your first subscription checkout.' Good UX.

seed_data_creation: Seeded a canceled subscription doc on barn_id=primary and linked barns.subscription_id, to drive the Resume CTA. Cleaned up after the run (deleted subscriptions where stripe_subscription_id=sub_test_15c and unset barns.subscription_id).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 spec features pass except the ' literal in SubscriptionSuccess.jsx — trivial fix. The in-card plan-cycle-toggle on /billing/subscription is hidden because /api/billing/plans returns has_monthly/has_annual=false (STRIPE price IDs unset). When testing that toggle in the future, either set STRIPE_PRICE_* env vars OR monkey-patch the plans response. Resume flow requires both subscriptions doc with status='canceled'|'past_due'|'unpaid'|'incomplete_expired' AND barns.subscription_id = that doc's id — purely setting subscriptions.barn_id is not enough because /subscriptions/me reads through barn.subscription_id.
rca of the issue: 1) Apostrophe bug: JSX text auto-decodes HTML entities, but inside a JS string literal it does not — author copy-pasted ' into the template. 2) Plan-toggle hidden: backend gates has_monthly/has_annual on presence of STRIPE_PRICE_* env vars, which are blank in this preview env. Neither blocks 15.C acceptance; the frontend code paths are correct.
